title: decode.rs and scan.rs allocate a Vec<u8> for every line lowercasing — O(n) allocs in a hot loop
description: uuencoding/src/decode.rs: every iteration of the begin-search loop allocates a Vec<u8> via .iter().map(|b| b.to_ascii_lowercase()).collect() (lines 28, 116). uuencoding/src/scan.rs: is_begin_line() and is_begin_base64() each allocate a Vec<u8> for lowercasing the entire line (lines 49, 55). For a large text/plain body with many lines before the begin block, this is O(lines) allocations before finding anything. The standard fix — eq_ignore_ascii_case, starts_with on the raw slice with a case-insensitive prefix check, or a small stack buffer — avoids all allocations.
acceptance_criteria: Replace per-line Vec<u8> lowercase allocations with allocation-free case-insensitive comparisons (e.g. line[..5].eq_ignore_ascii_case(b'begin')). Benchmark or note the line count in typical use.
close_reason: Replaced per-line Vec<u8> lowercase allocations with eq_ignore_ascii_case in uuencoding/src/decode.rs (scan.rs was already fixed)
